promotion_decision: Not promotable: the placements listed as unvalidated did not pass the factory drawing's callout check.
transformation: x = raw_x / 1257.0, y = raw_y / 1974.0, rounded to six places. Wall objects use the mean of their drag points; Light, Trigger, Bumper, Flipper, Spinner and Kicker objects their stored centre; HitTarget objects their stored position; the collidable primitives sw27a and sw34b, whose geometry is baked into the mesh at position (0,0,0) with no rotation, the centre of each connected mesh piece's bounding box after scaling the extracted OBJ vertices by the primitive's size (185.274). Objects are frozen in tools/seeds/bally/paragon-1979-spatial.json.
